# Battlegrounds content library

Machine-readable Hearthstone Battlegrounds (HSBG) card data for Bramble's power budgeting. HSBG is Bramble's rules baseline; these files are the reference for what stats a tier buys and what an effect costs.

*Generated by `tools/research/build_bg_library.py` on 2026-10-27. Do not edit by hand; re-run the script.*

## Source

- Data: [HearthstoneJSON](https://hearthstonejson.com/) `cards.json` (enUS), build **255790** (patch 37.0.0, 2026-10-26). This is the build `v1/latest` served on the run date.
- History: 83 builds from 2019-12-18 to 2026-10-26 (last build of each month). Build numbers and dates come from the [HearthSim/hsdata](https://github.com/HearthSim/hsdata) commit log ("Update to patch x.y.z.build"), falling back to the HTTP Last-Modified date of the file.
- Pool membership was cross-checked by hand against [hearthstone.wiki.gg](https://hearthstone.wiki.gg/) Battlegrounds pages where the JSON was ambiguous (see Known gaps).

## Files

| File | Rows | Contents |
|---|---|---|
| minions.json / minions.csv | 1021 | Every minion seen in the Tavern pool in a sampled build. Normal version; golden fields linked. |
| timewarp.json | 158 | Timewarped minions (bought in the separate Timewarp shop, not the Tavern pool). |
| spells.json | 208 | All `BATTLEGROUND_SPELL` cards: Tavern spells, upgrades and generated spells. |
| trinkets.json | 420 | All `BATTLEGROUND_TRINKET` cards (lesser and greater). |
| anomalies.json | 112 | All `BATTLEGROUND_ANOMALY` cards. |
| quests.json | 95 | Quests (`quests`) and quest rewards (`rewards`). |
| heroes.json | 128 | Every hero that was draftable in a sampled build, with armor and hero power. |
| buddies.json | 114 | Hero buddies (a 2022 feature, still in the data). |

Every JSON file is `{"meta": {...}, "cards": [...]}` (`quests.json` has `quests` and `rewards`). `text` is the rules text with HTML and layout markup removed. `effect_class` is `vanilla` (no text), `keyword_only` (text is only static keywords such as Taunt, Divine Shield, Reborn, Windfury, Venomous, Stealth, Magnetic) or `effect`. `vanilla_stats` = attack + health.

## Method

1. List builds from the hsdata commit log and the HearthstoneJSON index.
2. Sample builds: by default the last build of every calendar month since Dec 2019, plus the first and the newest build. `--every-build` diffs every build instead. First-seen and last-seen are therefore accurate to about a month.
3. For each sampled build, read the pool by era:
   - **flag** (Feb 2022 on): `isBattlegroundsPoolMinion` / `isBattlegroundsPoolSpell` / `battlegroundsHero`. Exact.
   - **techlevel** (Nov 2020 - Jan 2022): only pool minions carry `techLevel`, and all of them link a golden. Exact.
   - **heuristic** (Dec 2019 - Oct 2020): `techLevel` is also on tokens and goldens. Pool = `techLevel` minions that are not golden and not on a curated token list (below). Dates before Dec 2019 have no tier data at all.
4. Each build is reduced to a small snapshot (pool minions with goldens, draftable heroes with hero power, pool spells, and the ids of trinkets, anomalies, quests, rewards, buddies and spells present). Raw files are deleted after that, except the newest.
5. Current-pool minions take every field from the newest build. Historical minions take their fields from the last sampled build where they were in the pool (`stats_source_build`), so tier and stats are the ones they held then; their golden link comes from the newest build when the old build had none.
6. Trinkets, anomalies, quests, quest rewards and buddies have no pool flag in the data. Their files list every card of that type in the newest build, with the first sampled build in which it appeared (`first_in_data_build`), which approximates its release.

Era-A cards excluded as tokens or non-pool:

Amalgam (hero power token), Amalgam Explorer (hero power token), Big Bad Wolf (token), Damaged Golem (token), Emperor Cobra, classic EX1_170 (not in any 2019-2020 Tavern list; a separate Battlegrounds Emperor Cobra was added in Nov 2022), Finkle Einhorn (token), Guard Bot (token), Hench-Clan Squire (token), Hyena (token), Imp (token), Ironhide Runt (token), Jo-E Bot (token), Microbot (token), Murloc Scout (token), Plant (token), Primalfin (token), Rat (token), Robosaur (token), Sky Pirate (token), Snake (token), Spider (token), Tabbycat (token), Treasure Chest (token), Vault Safe (token), Water Droplet (token).

All ten agree on tier, stats and pool status, and the sampled pool periods line up with the wiki's removal and return patches. Six of the ten are no longer in the pool: Alleycat, Scallywag, Murloc Warleader, Cave Hydra, Baron Rivendare (left in Jan 2023, when Titus Rivendare arrived) and Amalgadon. One detail is unconfirmed: the data drops Kalecgos for the single Aug 2025 sample (build 226642) and has it back in Sep 2025; the wiki page does not mention that gap. For the heuristic era the wiki confirmed Whirlwind Tempest (removed in 18.4.2), and its removed-card list includes Zoobot, Shielded Minibot, Mounted Raptor, Annoy-o-Tron, Psych-o-Tron, Phalanx Commander, Cobalt Guardian, Festeroot Hulk, Tortollan Shellraiser, The Boogeymonster, Menagerie Magician, Arcane Cannon, Holy Mackerel, Sated Threshadon and Gentle Megasaur.

## Known gaps

- **Monthly sampling.** First-seen and last-seen dates are the sampled builds, accurate to about a month. A minion that was in the pool for less than a month between samples is missing, and a one-sample gap in `pool_periods` can be a real short removal or an odd build. Run with `--every-build` for patch-level dates.
- **Launch month.** Builds before 2019-12-18 (build 38377) export no `techLevel`, so the Nov 2019 launch pool is read from the Dec 2019 build.
- **Dec 2019 - Oct 2020 is heuristic.** Pool membership is inferred (see Method); the cards accepted only on that evidence are listed above. Golden links did not exist before Apr 2020, so golden fields for early-only minions come from the newest build when it still has them.
- **Pool means the whole pool.** `isBattlegroundsPoolMinion` covers every tribe; a lobby uses only some tribes. Per-lobby rules (tribe-restricted minions such as Wrath Weaver needing Demons) are not in the data. Duos-only minions are flagged `duos_exclusive`.
- **Reprints.** Classic minions were reissued as `BG_` copies in Aug 2022, and a few others were reprinted; each copy has its own dbfId and row. Group with the `lineage_*` fields; the all-era tables use `lineage_primary` rows only.
- **No pool flag for trinkets, anomalies, quests, quest rewards or buddies.** Those files hold every card of the type in the newest build, including variants and cards never or no longer offered. `first_in_data_build` is when the card entered the client, which can precede release.
- **Heroes.** `battlegroundsHero` history starts in spring 2020. Heroes that are temporarily disabled may still carry the flag. Armor is the newest build's value (older builds stored an armor tier instead). Only the default hero power is listed; cost 0 is usually a passive.
- **Dynamic text.** Quest text shows `0` where the game fills in a number; counters like "(3 Gold left!)" are kept as written. A few minions have display stats that are not their real budget (e.g. The Boommobile 30/30).
- **Keywords come from Blizzard's mechanics tags.** A minion that only grants a keyword lists it in `referenced_tags`, not `keywords`; Cave Hydra's cleave has no tag. `effect_class` is computed from the text, not the tags.
- **Timewarp.** `timewarp.json` lists Timewarped minions from the separate Timewarp shop. They are not in the Tavern pool, and their `tier` is exported as-is; it may not mean the same as a Tavern tier.
- **Version labels.** hsdata commit messages occasionally mislabel a patch (build 226642, Aug 2025, is labeled 32.2.2). Build numbers are reliable.
